---
title: "Representation and Electoral Systems"
---

***We tackle key questions in the fields of electoral systems and representation.***

Representation and Electoral Systems is a global community that promotes the research, teaching, and evaluation of electoral systems across various countries. We host events and build an infrastructure for exchanging ideas and supporting our collective scientific endeavors.

### News and announcements

- July, 2025: We will host a joint reception during the American Political Science Association Annual Meeting. For more, visit [Events](https://district-magnitude.github.io/events.html)

- June, 2025: We are soft launching our mailing list district-magnitude (DM). For more, see [Connect](https://district-magnitude.github.io/connect.html)

- March, 2025: The leadership transitioned into a new team. See more, visit [About/People](https://district-magnitude.github.io/people.html)
